messages:
jess (support): customer ACME reporting intermittent 502 + EOFs on /v1/stream (eu1) since ~2024-10-12T11:03Z. ticket S-4231. they say stream produces a few tokens then connection closes. any quick triage?

maria (sre): pulled edge logs 11:03-11:10 UTC. seeing a cluster of upstream resets and unexpected EOFs. sample lines from envoy: 
```
[2024-10-12T11:04:23Z] envoy upstream reset before response complete: code=ECONNRESET, upstream=10.3.45.8:443
[2024-10-12T11:04:23Z] envoy connection closed by peer (unexpected EOF)
[2024-10-12T11:04:24Z] envoy http2 stream error: PROTOCOL_ERROR, stream_id=17
```

jess (support): customer included a curl that reproduces locally:
```bash
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -N https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"long streaming test"}'
```

ben (oncall): can we get a few trace ids and the client IP? also check edge metrics: upstream_cx_reset, upstream_rq_5xx, and upstream_cx_failure for eu1. any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy deploy-20241012-1058-eu1 completed at 2024-10-12T10:58:12Z, service=auth-service, rollout=progressive, note="auth-meta-v5 header flag enabled"

maria (sre): metrics from 11:02->11:06 UTC: upstream_cx_reset +260%, upstream_rq_5xx +140%, upstream_cx_close_with_active_rq spike. traces show repeated upstream host 10.3.45.8 failing mid-response.

tom (eng-runtime): possibilities: (1) auth-service started adding a large auth metadata header that pushes request into proxy edge limits, (2) backend model host hitting connection-reset on long-lived h2 streams, or (3) a midproxy keepalive/idle timeout mismatch after the auth deploy. check nginx/ingress logs for 431/large header entries and midproxy h2 window errors.

jess (support): customer trace ids: t-eu1-11-04-0567, t-eu1-11-04-0599. client IP: 35.201.12.8. they say this happens ~1 in 10 streams.

maria (sre): looked up trace t-eu1-11-04-0599: edge received request, forwarded to upstream, upstream sent initial chunks then connection aborted with RST_STREAM. midproxy logs include: 
```
[2024-10-12T11:04:23Z] midproxy: http2: received SETTINGS frame with invalid window size
[2024-10-12T11:04:23Z] midproxy: conn reset by peer during body write
```

ben (oncall): let's collect tcpdump on the edge pod and upstream host for one minute around reproduction. also increase upstream idle timeout on envoy by +5s as a short-term mitigation. can we temporarily route ACME to a different pool or disable auth-meta-v5?

tom (eng-runtime): i reviewed the auth-service PR. new header x-auth-meta-v5 can be ~2.5kb in some cases (session history). that could break some intermediate proxies or bump header parsing cost and trigger resets on long streams. recommend disabling the flag in eu1 immediately. i'll stand by to rollback.

jess (support): requested rollback with platform team; customer ok with temporary workaround.

deploy-bot: rollback job deploy-rollback-20241012-1112-eu1 started by jess, target=auth-service, flag=auth-meta-v5 OFF

maria (sre): after rollback at 2024-10-12T11:12 UTC, upstream_cx_reset and 502 rates fell back to baseline within ~3m. I still see a handful of stale traces but frequency is normal now.

jess (support): customer confirmed streaming recovered after 11:15 UTC and no more EOFs. ticket S-4231 updated and customer notified.

ben (oncall): next steps: add a metric alert for sudden increase in upstream_cx_reset, add a short-lived safeguard to reject oversized auth headers at the edge with 431 and clear logging, and schedule a postmortem with auth-service to bound header sizes.

tom (eng-runtime): i'll add a check in the deployment pipeline to block enabling auth-meta-v5 globally until header size gating is in place.

maria (sre): attaching the two trace ids and the relevant envoy/midproxy snippets to the ticket. closing the Slack thread once docs updated.
